bio: The journey up to this enchanting mountain village is something of an adventure, but the food makes it worth it! In a rustic chalet-style setting, diners tuck into flavoursome regional dishes prepared with seasonal produce – the chef is always happy to showcase Swiss ingredients. The menu features mouthwatering options such as Mario's Signature Black Forest (beef sirloin, sour cherries, cocoa, kirsch 40% volume) and the Alpen Tapas starter. Friendly and charming front-of-house team....
